{{Quote|I hope you remember this and one day do me a favor. He's not that far away. He's at the Spider Arms Hostel.|Jan Dez when asked about the whereabouts of the pickpocket Bannamu|<ref name="Lightsaber Lost">{{TCW|Lightsaber Lost}}</ref>}}
'''Jan Dez''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] criminal on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and acted as an associate to the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Lauli Wahlo/Legends|Lauli Wahlo]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. At one point, the two were approached by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Tera Sinube/Legends|Tera Sinube]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who was looking for her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], which had been stolen from her. Once she revealed herself to be a Jedi, the nervous counterpart revealed to her that the lightsaber had been pilfered by the [[Patrolian/Legends|Patrolian]] criminal [[Bannamu/Legends|Bannamu]], and Dez indicated that he could be found at the [[Spider Arms Hostel/Legends|Spider Arms Hostel]].
